name: Conditional union with complex filtering
sql:
SELECT name, CAST(mvp_awards AS INT) AS count, 'MVP Awards' AS metric
FROM player
WHERE CAST(mvp_awards AS INT) >= 2
UNION
SELECT name, CAST(nba_championships AS INT) AS count, 'Championships' AS metric
FROM player
WHERE CAST(nba_championships AS INT) >= 2
LIMIT 100
